scene: Inside the greenhouse, a glass transit terminal connects the city. Which way?
picture: Flat side view. On the left, an open subterranean hatch holds a silver subway train. Just right of it, the player stands holding her red umbrella. At centre sits an open yellow street tram. On the right, a blue harbour ferry bobs in a tiled canal basin, ready for passengers.
shown: a sleek silver subway train idling at an open hatch on the left
a yellow street tram stopped on gleaming rails at centre
a blue harbour ferry floating in an indoor canal on the right
